biotools.summary: RABiTPy is an open-source Python package designed for rapid, AI-powered bacterial tracking and analysis, supporting various image and video formats with options for traditional and AI-based segmentation. It offers comprehensive spatiotemporal analyses suitable for researchers with varying coding experience.
